name: Prepaint snapshot emptiness

atomicDiscipline.rule: Run exactly the printed hypothesis. If the attempted change fails, degrades, or suggests a different fix, revert to the checkpoint and finish this experiment as failure. Start a new experiment for the next idea.

hypothesisMarkdown:
# Hypothesis

Editable-text prepaint currently materializes the complete `TextBufferSnapshot` solely to decide
whether a placeholder should be drawn. Using the snapshot's constant-time `is_empty` query removes
that allocation from every prepaint without changing layout, paint, selection, or placeholder
semantics.

## Scope lock

This experiment changes only the placeholder emptiness check in editable-text prepaint. It does
not change row iteration, culling, cache retention, or editing behavior.
measurementPlanMarkdown:
# Measurement plan

Run the existing page-isolated headed WASM/WebGPU TextArea wheel fixture at DPR 1 and 2 with five
warmups and thirty measured samples each. Inspect its DPR 2 screenshot and retain raw timing JSON.
Source inspection must prove prepaint no longer calls `snapshot.text()`.
expectedOutcomeMarkdown:
# Expected outcome

Scrolling the large populated TextArea remains visibly unchanged, including selection and the
scrolled viewport. The placeholder remains present only for empty content, while prepaint no
longer allocates a whole text string merely to detect that condition.

measurements.target: headed WASM WebGPU TextArea wheel action
measurements.protocol: One page-isolated 35-run Playwright process per DPR with five warmups and thirty measured samples.

reportMarkdown:
# Prepaint snapshot emptiness

The focused headed WASM/WebGPU TextArea fixture passed all 70 samples and its DPR 2 screenshot
showed the expected scrolled populated text. Replacing the placeholder check's whole-snapshot
string allocation produced a mixed timing result, so it is not retained.

| DPR | Prior p50/p95 | Candidate p50/p95 | Change p50/p95 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 129.493 / 141.935 ms | 137.592 / 144.960 ms | +6.3% / +2.1% |
| 2 | 137.290 / 143.619 ms | 133.411 / 145.400 ms | -2.8% / +1.2% |

The candidate is rejected because it regresses DPR 1 and DPR 2 p95. The raw output preserves all
timings and screenshots; the source is restored to the checkpoint.
decisionMarkdown:
# Decision

Reject the snapshot emptiness substitution. Although it removes a direct allocation, the fixed
WASM benchmark is mixed and does not establish a reliable performance improvement.
